name: B10-0528/2026 (PPE) – Soutien à la candidature de villes de l'Union pour accueillir un nouveau pôle des Nations unies pour l’évaluation indépendante et la gouvernance éthique de l’IA
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It says the European Union should back the idea of a new United Nations body that would check artificial intelligence systems independently and set ethical rules for them. It also says European cities that want to host this body should be supported. The Parliament asks the European Commission, the Council and the High Representative to work together to help those cities.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only gives its support and asks others to act.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the Commission, the High Representative, and European cities bidding to host the body.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, EU governments, the Council of Europe and the UN Secretary-General.
